Repeated success alternatives praise Maria after the scorpions flee; a separate failure injures Maria and requires one day's treatment. The quiet-departure branch warns against provoking the scorpions, but a sailor drops baggage, causing a thud and a cry, then Maria orders everyone to run and a sailor-injury notice follows. Preserve every physical alternative, different injury targets, urgency, one-day stay and uncertain sailor-injury report. Do not invent poison, death, a guaranteed successful escape, lost cargo quantities or simultaneous branch activation. Dynamic218's treatment warning needs native identity/voice binding. All ordinary wraps are formatter-owned.
records.localization_note: The notice hedges about the injured crew. The Japanese noun can describe the crew collectively.
records.previous_English: A sailor seems to have been injured.
records.english: It looks like a sailor was injured.
records.display_scope: Native renderer and direct visual check
